heroHeadline: Day 961: 37 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline — Knesset Kallner Bill Advancing Toward Late-May Plenum Vote; NILI Task Force Continues Systematic Elimination of All ~3,000 October 7 Participants; Beyachad Alliance Reaffirms Day-1 Independent Commission Pledge
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 25, 2026 (Day 961 / Ceasefire Day 228): 37 days remain until the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1 accountability deadline — the court called the 32-month absence of any October 7 investigation 'unacceptable.' The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill — which dropped 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from its purpose clause, bars judges, and requires an 80-MK supermajority — is advancing toward a late-May first Knesset plenum reading. The Beyachad alliance (Naftali Bennett + Yair Lapid, formed May 11) pledges an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government; 72% of Israelis (Hebrew University, Apr 2026) favor an independent inquiry. The secret NILI task force (Shin Bet + Mossad, revealed WSJ May 21-22) continues its kill-or-capture campaign against all ~3,000 October 7 participants through the ceasefire — 'hundreds' crossed off the list. On May 23 (Day 959): France banned National Security Minister Ben Gvir; bereaved mother Maayan Sherman said refusal to form a commission 'spits on Ron's grave.' On May 21-22 (Day 957-958): Board of Peace six-month UNSC report named Hamas 'principal obstacle' to Phase Two; IDF documented 19 Hamas ceasefire violations May 6-20. On May 16 (Day 952): IDF killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad — last senior October 7 architect in Gaza. Phase Two deadlock persists. 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire (Oct 10, 2025). All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
